SB19 is the Serbian national under-19 championship of SuperLiga and First League youth sides, not a senior league. No season article exists for it ('Омладинска лига Србије', 'Омладинска лига Србије 2026/27.', 'Serbian U19 League' all missing on sr/en Wikipedia) and no fixture list was found. The quoted line is the SER1 window that the asset's 07-17 start was inherited from, not this competition's own window. No proxy used - a youth competition's calendar is not derivable from the senior one.
